T: Once upon a time in Nazi occupied France
D: A Jewish cinema owner in occupied Paris and a squad of American commandos both plan to wipe out the Nazi high command at one film premiere.
P: Serve the strudel when Landa orders Shosanna a glass of milk.
S: LaPadite farm fromage blanc with honey and warm baguette
Landa thanks LaPadite for the milk

Whip the fromage blanc with the cream, lemon zest and a pinch of salt until smooth and light. Warm the honey with the thyme leaves for a minute and let it sit. Slice the baguette, brush with oil and warm in a 200C oven until crisp at the edges. Spread the cheese in a shallow bowl, pour over the thyme honey and finish with salt flakes. Serve with the bread.
Wiener schnitzel fingers with lemon and capers

Season the flour, beat the eggs and set out the breadcrumbs. Dip each veal finger in flour, egg, then crumbs, pressing them on. Shallow-fry in hot oil in batches until golden, about 2 minutes a side, then drain. Brown the butter in a small pan, add the capers until they pop, then spoon over with parsley and lemon.
M: Gorlomi veal saltimbocca with sage and Marsala

Bring the milk and water to the boil, whisk in the polenta and stir until thick, then beat in half the butter and the parmesan. Lay a slice of prosciutto and two sage leaves on each escalope and pin with a toothpick. Dust the veal with flour and fry, prosciutto side down first, in the oil and a little butter, 2 minutes a side. Lift the veal out, add the Marsala and stock to the pan and boil until syrupy, then swirl in the remaining butter. Spoon the polenta onto plates, top with the veal and pour over the pan sauce.
1l milk and water, half and half@Dairy

Fry the speck in a heavy pot until the fat runs, then soften the onion in it. Stir in the sauerkraut, apple, juniper and bay, then pour in the stock and apple juice. Bury the pork in the cabbage, cover and braise at 160C for an hour. Add the sausages and whole potatoes and braise until the potatoes are tender. Pile onto a board, slice the pork and serve with plenty of mustard.
W: Landa's apple strudel with whipped cream
Landa says wait for the cream

Toss the apples with the raisins, sugar, cinnamon, lemon zest and juice. Fry the breadcrumbs in 2 tbsp of the butter until golden. Layer the filo, brushing each sheet with butter, then scatter the crumbs along one long edge and pile the apples on top. Roll up tightly, tuck in the ends, brush with butter and bake at 190C until deep golden. Whip the cream to soft peaks, dust the strudel with icing sugar and serve it warm with the cold cream.
